templates.name: Pain-Point Flow
templates.when_to_use: A reader feels a daily pain and wants the exact 4-step fix with before/after proof.
templates.dynamic: Moving arrows between steps, closed-loop return highway, traveling packets, upgrade arrow.

templates.name: Split-Path Divergence
templates.when_to_use: Two paths look identical at the start but diverge (security, reliability, compliance).
templates.dynamic: Green vs. red packet streams, purple control-intercept flows, pulsing invariant.

templates.name: Hub-and-Spoke Core
templates.when_to_use: One central engine with many orbiting subsystems (harness layers, platform services).
templates.dynamic: 10 spokes streaming packets into a pulsing core.

templates.name: Layered Stack
templates.when_to_use: Explain a platform from foundation to experience with guarantees per layer.
templates.dynamic: Request descends on the left rail, verified response ascends on the right rail.

templates.name: Closed-Loop Cycle
templates.when_to_use: A process repeats until a gate exits (agent loops, CI loops, retraining).
templates.dynamic: Packets orbit the loop arcs; entry and exit arrows; pulsing core.

templates.name: Sequence Diagram
templates.when_to_use: Show exactly who calls whom, in what order, including retry loops.
templates.dynamic: Numbered messages stream packets between lifelines; loop fragment highlighted.

templates.name: Decision Tree
templates.when_to_use: A routing policy or architectural decision with 2-3 gates.
templates.dynamic: YES/NO branches carry packets to color-coded outcomes.

templates.name: Benchmark Bars
templates.when_to_use: Before/after measurements with sources and deltas.
templates.dynamic: Bars grow on load; delta pills; methodology panel.

templates.name: Evolution Timeline
templates.when_to_use: How a field evolved and why each era's failure created the next architecture.
templates.dynamic: Packets travel the spine; era cards alternate above/below; pattern chain arrows.

templates.name: Refinement Funnel
templates.when_to_use: Large raw input is filtered through gates into a few promoted outputs.
templates.dynamic: Packets fall through the funnel; stage filters connect to annotation cards.

templates.name: 2x2 Quadrant Map
templates.when_to_use: Position options on two axes and show the migration path to the target quadrant.
templates.dynamic: Breathing dots, axis flows, dashed migration arrows with labels.

templates.name: Anatomy Callouts
templates.when_to_use: Explain each part of a prompt, brief, config, or payload and why it matters.
templates.dynamic: Leader packets flow from 6 callouts into the central artifact.

templates.name: Bad vs. Good Diff
templates.when_to_use: Show the naive implementation next to the production one, line by line.
templates.dynamic: Transformation arrows jump from the bad lines to the fixed lines.

templates.name: Audit Scorecard
templates.when_to_use: A pass/partial/fail audit with evidence and the next fixes.
templates.dynamic: Scan packet sweeps the rows; FAIL pills blink; gauge arc fills.

templates.name: Radial Mind Map
templates.when_to_use: Map a field: center topic, 6 branches, 18 grounded leaves.
templates.dynamic: Curved branch flows stream packets outward from a pulsing center.

templates.name: Maturity Heatmap
templates.when_to_use: Compare levels or options across capabilities with a highlighted recommendation.
templates.dynamic: Recommended column pulses with a vertical scan; color-graded cells.

templates.name: KPI Dashboard Tiles
templates.when_to_use: Six headline metrics with trend, delta, and measurement method.
templates.dynamic: Packets trace each sparkline from BEFORE to AFTER.

templates.name: Repo Tree Map
templates.when_to_use: Walk readers through a repository: file -> responsibility -> architectural tier.
templates.dynamic: Leader packets link tree rows to responsibility cards and tier badges.

templates.name: Myth vs. Reality
templates.when_to_use: Bust 5 common assumptions with evidence-backed realities.
templates.dynamic: GROUNDED FIX arrows carry packets from each myth to its reality.

templates.name: Radar Evaluation
templates.when_to_use: Compare two designs across 6 dimensions with a rubric.
templates.dynamic: Polygon grows into place while packets orbit its outline.
